package main

import sdk "example.com/godj-openapi-client/inventoryapi"

const evolved = false

func setNewField(*sdk.AssetInput)             {}
func defaultProjection(value *sdk.Asset) bool { return value.Note.Null }
func explicitProjection(value *sdk.Asset) bool {
	return !value.Note.Null && value.Note.Value == "client note"
}
func requestFields() []string  { return []string{"Code", "Enabled", "Note"} }
func responseFields() []string { return []string{"Code", "Enabled", "ID", "Note"} }
func requestPolicy() bool      { return true }
